name: Top adverse reactions
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.preferred_term, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 15

name: Drug reaction pairs
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug {name: 'ASPIRIN'}) WITH c LIMIT 500 MATCH (c)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.preferred_term, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 10

name: Elderly cases (age > 65)
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase) WHERE c.age > 65 RETURN count(c) AS elderly_cases

name: Drugs with most reactions
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) WITH d, count(DISTINCT c) AS cases WHERE cases > 100 WITH d, cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 20 MATCH (c2:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d) WITH d, cases, c2 LIMIT 5000 MATCH (c2)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction) RETURN d.name, cases, count(DISTINCT r.preferred_term) AS unique_reactions ORDER BY unique_reactions DESC LIMIT 10

name: Hepatotoxicity drugs
cypher: MATCH (r:Reaction) WHERE r.preferred_term IS NOT NULL AND r.preferred_term CONTAINS 'HEPAT' WITH r MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r) WITH c LIMIT 5000 MATCH (c)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) WITH d, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN d.name, cases

name: QT prolongation drugs
cypher: MATCH (r:Reaction) WHERE r.preferred_term IS NOT NULL AND (r.preferred_term CONTAINS 'QT PROLONGATION' OR r.preferred_term CONTAINS 'TORSADE') WITH r MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r) WITH c LIMIT 5000 MATCH (c)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) WITH d, count(c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN d.name, cases

name: Polypharmacy cases (5+ drugs)
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) WITH c, count(d) AS drug_count LIMIT 100000 WHERE drug_count >= 5 RETURN count(c) AS polypharmacy_cases

name: Serious reaction - death
cypher: MATCH (c:AdverseEventCase)-[:EXPERIENCED]->(r:Reaction {preferred_term: 'DEATH'}) WITH c LIMIT 500 MATCH (c)-[:REPORTED_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN d.name, count(c) AS deaths ORDER BY deaths DESC LIMIT 10
